example.title: Galena Doorways, Sisters of Mercy Convent, 226 North Bench Street

brief: St. Brendan's convent: a one-and-a-half-storey brick building of the early 1840s with stepped-parapet gable ends and chimneys, tall round-headed windows along the side, standing hard against the sidewalk above a stone retaining wall on a sloping street, with a small porch on the uphill end. Record gap: 1 photo only (the HABS doorway survey); massing follows the photo, detailing follows the town's other early brick buildings.
label: St. Brendan's
